description: Tool to create a roll-up property. Use when consolidating multiple GA4 properties into one aggregated view.

inputSchema.description: Request model for creating a GA4 Roll-up Property using properties.createRollupProperty.

account.description: Required. Parent account resource. Format: accounts/{account_id}
account.title: Account

displayName.description: Required. Display name for the roll-up property.
displayName.title: Display Name

sourceProperties.description: Optional. List of source property resource names to link. Format: properties/{property_id}.
sourceProperties.title: Source Properties

timeZone.description: Required. IANA time zone for the roll-up property.
timeZone.title: Time Zone

inputSchema.title: CreateRollupPropertyRequest

name: create_rollup_property

rollupPropertySourceLinks.description: The created roll-up property source links (if any).
rollupPropertySourceLinks.title: Rollup Property Source Links

RollupProperty.description: Schema for a GA4 Property resource returned by createRollupProperty.

name.description: Resource name of this property. Format: properties/{property_id}.
name.title: Name

RollupProperty.title: RollupProperty

RollupPropertySourceLink.description: Schema for a roll-up property source link resource.

name.description: Resource name of this link. Format: properties/{property_id}/rollupPropertySourceLinks/{link_id}.
name.title: Name

sourceProperty.description: Immutable. Resource name of the source property. Format: properties/{property_id}.
sourceProperty.title: Source Property
